edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the _from address for transferFrom
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from to decide allowance spending
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
delegate() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner) before arbitrary delegatecall
_mints() authorizes via msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded backdoor address
init() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner)
batchSend() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress() authorizes via require(msg.sender == owner)
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the caller
transfer() returns transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances
ensure() calls condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted
ensure() reads tradeAddress for the whitelist comparison
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass the sale condition
condition() reads _saleNum to cap the number of sales
condition() reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom reads and decreases allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after the transfer
balanceOf and allowance are decremented with unchecked subtraction, enabling underflow
balanceOf[_to] is incremented with unchecked addition, enabling overflow
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection
batchSend subtracts total from and adds _value to balanceOf entries in a loop
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall with caller-controlled address and calldata
The delegatecall executes attacker code that can re-enter state-mutating functions such as transferFrom before accounting completes
_mints() permanently sets canSale[spender] = true, bypassing ensure/condition
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary amount
init() sets _minSale used by condition()
init() sets _maxSale used by condition()
init() sets _saleNum used by condition()
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress whitelist used by ensure()
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply
constructor grants infinite allowance to the Uniswap router
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals
constructor sets the token name
constructor sets the token symbol
pairFor() is used by ensure() to compute the address(this) pair compared against tradeAddress

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a transient parameter of transferFrom and carries no standalone security semantics beyond that function's balance/allowance checks
_to is a transient parameter of transferFrom used only for the destination balance update
_value is a transient parameter of transferFrom consumed by the unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic
a is the caller-supplied delegatecall target of delegate and must be analyzed as part of that unsafe operation
b is the caller-supplied delegatecall calldata of delegate and must be analyzed as part of that unsafe operation
_tos is only the recipient array iterated by batchSend
_value of batchSend only feeds the unchecked total computation and per-recipient credit
total is the intermediate result of the unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length
i is only the loop counter controlling the batchSend distribution loop
